question: Select the one-word substitute for "a person who finds pleasure in their own pain or humiliation."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Masochist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Masochist"** refers to a person who derives pleasure, especially sexual gratification, from their own pain or humiliation. (दुखभोगी)
 
 
• **Example:** He was a masochist who found satisfaction in enduring challenges that others would avoid.
 
 
• In the given question, the word "Masochist" perfectly aligns with the definition of a person who finds pleasure in their own pain or humiliation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Masochist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Narcissist** (आत्ममुग्ध): A person who has an excessive interest in or admiration of themselves.
 
 
• **Example:** The narcissist couldn't stop looking at their own reflection in the mirror.
 
 

 
• **Pessimist** (निराशावादी): A person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believes that the worst will happen.
 
 
• **Example:** The pessimist always assumes that everything will go wrong, no matter the circumstances.
 
 

 
• **Hedonist** (सुखवादी): A person who believes that the pursuit of pleasure is the most important thing in life.
 
 
• **Example:** As a hedonist, she spent her weekends indulging in luxurious spa treatments and fine dining.
